name: Forte: Volume Booster & Equalizer
summary: Make any site louder, up to 600%, without crackling: a built-in limiter keeps the boost clean. 10-band equalizer with presets (voice, bass, treble), volume per site, one-click off. Free, no ads, no tracking.
description:
Forte boosts and shapes the sound of video and audio players on any website: news sites, online courses, podcasts, streaming services, video calls in the browser, quiet laptop speakers and everything else that plays in Firefox.

**What it does**
- Volume from 0% to 600%, with quick presets and a slider
- A limiter that holds peaks just under full scale, so even a big boost stays clean instead of crackling
- 10-band equalizer with presets: Voice / dialogue, Bass boost, Treble boost, Loudness, Laptop speakers, Rock, Pop, Electronic, Classical, Acoustic and more, or drag the bands yourself
- "Even out loud and quiet parts" (night mode): quiet dialogue up, sudden explosions down
- Mono and left/right balance, handy with one earbud or uneven speakers
- Remembers your volume and EQ per site, or one setting everywhere
- Turn it off for a site with one click
- The toolbar icon shows the boost on each tab, and a live level meter shows when the limiter is working
- Works in embedded players, iframes and players hidden in shadow DOM
- Works on Firefox for Android

**It won't mute your videos**
Firefox only lets add-ons process sound that comes from the same site, or from a server that allows it. Boosters that ignore this turn some videos silent. Forte checks every player first and leaves the ones it can't process playing normally, and tells you so in the popup. It also changes nothing at all until you raise the volume or pick an EQ preset.

**Plays well with others**
Works on YouTube and Twitch like on any other site. A player that another add-on, or the site itself, already processes is left alone, so the sound is never processed twice. Speed add-ons such as Tempo: Video Speed Controller keep working alongside it.

**Free, for real**
Every feature is unlocked for everyone. No ads, no account, no analytics. Your settings stay in your browser and are never sent anywhere.

If Forte helps and you'd like to say thanks, there's a Ko-fi link in the popup. It's entirely optional and unlocks nothing.

**Permissions**
"Access your data for all websites" is needed so Forte can find and process audio and video players on whatever site you use. Forte only touches media players; it does not read or send page content.
